test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 03
subject: general
question:
Two statements are followed by two conclusions. Assuming that the statements are true even if they do not conform to real world knowledge, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some fruits are vegetables.

2. All apples are fruits.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some apples are vegetables.

II. All apples are vegetables.
solution:
Given:

1. All apples are fruits.

2. Some fruits are vegetables.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ae0ce6d331384e83cc1b51675ddeff14f0cee6cc5d0ca8001324a97f84fc7e5.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some apples are vegetables ⇒ **False** (as there is no direct relation or any definite case between vegetables and apples

II. All apples are vegetables ⇒ **False** (totally indefinite case)

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option (4)**".
